Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection checklist I1, which must be performed every three months as 
indicated by M3 in the title block
Technical Specifications:

The 12 V -71- Detroit diesel engine (starting - 500 HP detroit diesel engine), 
the diesel is a 12 cylinder, 2 cycle engine, with a speed rating of 2300 rpm

first draft initiated by eng. Tamer Ghonem, test by eng. 
Rasha Ellabban, accepted by eng. Sawsan El lithe 
general manager, revised by eng. 
Zakaria El-Shahat 
EDEPC MPIS coordinator and approved by 
eng. Mohamed Hussein Gomaa quality insurance head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued.
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes eye glass, nose mouth dust cover ... etc

Testing the 
diesel starter motor 
(march)

Check the brushes of the 
motor and changing them if needed.

Measure the motor coil 
insulation.

Run the motor on load 
by connecting the switch No: 4 in the motor control center and pressing push 
button 43 DE and observing the march motor running.
